decision_scope: Close the user-authorized RunPod placement-pivot branch. The campaign still cannot test matched stock, tuned, representation, quality, or co-design economics because no resumed Phase-B request created a pod.
rubric_trigger: Gate B has no valid stock SLO-goodput point after four campaign Phase-B requests across two A100 80 GB provider SKUs and distinct cloud/datacenter pools. The two-placement A100-SXM hypothesis is exhausted, and no documented API reservation or cached-image Pod selector is available.
measured_results: Authenticated RunPod REST inventory, billing, templates, create, and prior delete-verification paths work with the account API key.
The refreshed campaign suite passes 71/71 tests and the GLM experiment suite passes 21/21 tests.
Before the resumed branch, both Community and Secure A100 PCIe requests returned HTTP 500 before pod creation and added $0.
The exact Secure US-KS-2 A100-SXM request returned HTTP 500 before pod creation in 1.459 seconds and added $0.
The separately preregistered Secure US-MD-1 A100-SXM request returned HTTP 500 before pod creation in 1.419 seconds and added $0.
The US-MD-1 provider response was safely captured and hashed. Its allowlisted body reported an internal deployment-response parsing failure: invalid character 'I' looking for beginning of value.

RunPod exact availability labeled US-KS-2 Low even immediately after its rejected POST and labeled US-MD-1 Medium before its rejected POST. The stock endpoint was therefore not transactional placement evidence.
No account templates or capacity reservations exist; the public Pod schema exposes no machine or cached-image host selector.
Final direct inventory contains zero pods. Billing remains 22 rows and $4.944724685296023 provider-settled account lifetime spend.
Campaign-additional spend remains $0.273464527, entirely the conservative charge for the earlier interrupted L40S allocation. All four Phase-B requests added $0.
No valid BF16 throughput, TTFT, token-level ITL/TPOT, SLO-goodput, provisional quality, GPU-dollar-per-token, tuned-stack, AWQ, intervention, or hardware comparison exists.
analytical_estimates: The prospective A100-SXM c8 point estimate was 275 conservative output tokens/second with a 150 to 450 interval; it remains unscored because neither placement created a pod.
The US-MD-1 allocation probability was estimated at 0.75 from a Medium exact stock label; the observed rejection shows that estimate was not calibrated to RunPod's backend deployment failure mode.
Published provider prices remain commercial anchors only and cannot support a matched cost claim.
vendor_claims: RunPod documents non-interruptible Pods as dedicated after allocation, but this is not an initial-capacity reservation.
RunPod documents sales-arranged reserved clusters and a console-only Deploy When Available queue; neither is an immediate public direct-API Pod placement mechanism for this campaign.
RunPod documents Serverless cached models, but that product changes the serving and billing control and is not the frozen Pod stock harness.
claims_not_supported: No tuned-incumbent or model-specific serving gain.
No AWQ compatibility, quality, throughput, or economic gain.
No Fireworks, Baseten, Cloudflare, or other provider performance comparison.
No memory-hierarchy or hardware co-design benefit.
No PROMOTE case for a larger campaign.
why_not_continue_spending: Both exact A100-SXM datacenter placements are exhausted and may not be repeated unchanged.
The provider's internal parsing error occurs before any model or telemetry boundary, so changing model/runtime code cannot fix it.
Historical H100 requests repeatedly missed cold image readiness; another best-effort cold H100 request would violate the campaign's low-information retry rule.
The account has no reservation, template, persistent model cache, or API-selectable pre-pulled host that would create the required causal placement change.
Phase C and later work remain gated on a valid stock and tuned baseline; spending on AWQ or kernels now would not permit the requested matched economics conclusion.

single_next_experiment_after_external_st.experiment: Run the existing frozen 25-request native-BF16 stock harness once after RunPod provides a documented reservation or API-visible deploy queue on an 80 GB NVIDIA host with the exact image confirmed ready; run the matched tuned control on that same allocated machine only if stock passes.
single_next_experiment_after_external_st.required_external_change: A transactional capacity mechanism or provider-confirmed reserved/cache-ready placement must exist. A new aggregate Low/Medium stock label is insufficient.
single_next_experiment_after_external_st.information_value: This would isolate model/runtime/SLO behavior from the pre-allocation provider failures that currently dominate the campaign.
not_authorized_or_admissible_now: another best-effort A100 PCIe, A100 SXM, or cold H100 request
